title: Grateful Dead Live at Curtis Hixon Convention Hall on 1973-12-19

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the Dec 19 1973 show, highlighted by a transcendent Here Comes Sunshine jam and stellar Keith keyboard outro.
ai_review.review: The leftovers release finishes the legendary December 19, 1973 concert with crystal‑clear soundboard fidelity, letting listeners hear every nuance of the band’s late‑’73 jazzy peak. Reviewers rave about the soaring Here Comes Sunshine improvisation, the “Candyman/​Dire Wolf” sequence and a wildly inventive keyboard outro after Truckin’, while noting no audible flaws in the mix.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive 5‑star comments, consistent praise for both performance and recording quality, with many reviewers calling it a top‑tier Dead jam; few minor critiques do not affect the high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the release as crisp, well‑balanced and faithful to the original two‑track tapes; no complaints about dropouts, muddiness or mix issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The leftovers complete the show in proper order, delivering a smooth flow from jazzy early‑set material into an expansive second set highlighted by extended improvisations.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers note Jerry’s transcendent guitar work during the Here Comes Sunshine jam and his overall tonal brilliance throughout the night.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's post‑Truckin' outro is called “ridiculous” in a good way, with him “beating on the keys like they owed him money.”
